title: MarshalEffectivePolicy
description: The composed EffectivePolicy's wire shape (AD-10, AD-16, AD-26, AD-27, AD-35): the closed 15-key policy vocabulary, each key a {value, layer, raw_source} PolicyField. additionalProperties is false at both the document and the PolicyField level -- an unrecognized/typo'd key is a schema violation, matching envelope.v1.json's own discipline. This is the exact shape cli/config.py's materialize() writes to <target_dir>/policy-<content_hash>.json (core/policy.py stays pure and never touches a file); `marshal config --format json` nests one of these documents under its envelope's data.policy key alongside data.content_hash.

verify_commands.description: STATIC. The allowlisted verify commands (AD-17) -- a tuple of str.

worktree_seed_paths.description: STATIC. GENERATED from the active project slug (FR-50), never a literal -- the project-derived path plus the marker path (when a valid slug exists; the marker path alone otherwise, with MRS-POLICY-005/006 reported) plus any extra paths the project layer declares.

merge_subject_template.description: STATIC. The merge-subject template string (AD-24) -- validated as a non-empty str only; placeholder-shape conformance is core/identity.py's own concern.

model_tier_map.description: STATIC. A mapping of difficulty-class name to {stage: model_name}; stage names are drawn from the closed set {dev, review, triage}.

epic_surfaces.description: STATIC (Story 2.3, AD-27). A mapping of epic number (as a string key) to a tuple of glob strings -- the per-epic writable-surface allowlist core/gate.py::compute_effective_surface intersects against a story spec's own declared surface. Never narrowed at runtime by a journal entry, unlike frozen_surfaces below.

gate_mode.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). One of {none, per-epic, per-story-spec-approval}; the INITIAL value only -- the live value during a run comes solely from the journal fold.

frozen_surfaces.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). The initial frozen-surface set; a tuple of str paths.

max_dev_attempts.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). A non-negative int ceiling.

max_review_cycles.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). A non-negative int ceiling.

max_followup_reviews.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). A non-negative int ceiling.

idle_threshold_minutes.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). A strictly positive number (Story 3.5, FR-12): the supervisor's idle-ladder threshold in minutes; the INITIAL value only.

max_tokens_per_story.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). A strictly positive number (Story 3.6, FR-13): the externally-enforced per-story token ceiling (weighted total); the INITIAL value only.

max_tokens_per_run.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). A strictly positive number (Story 3.6, FR-13): the externally-enforced per-run token ceiling (weighted total); the INITIAL value only.

max_wall_clock_minutes_per_story.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). A strictly positive number (Story 3.6, FR-13): the externally-enforced per-story wall-clock ceiling in minutes; the INITIAL value only.

max_wall_clock_minutes_per_run.description: SEED (AD-26) -- reachable only via EffectivePolicy.seed_view(). A strictly positive number (Story 3.6, FR-13): the externally-enforced per-run wall-clock ceiling in minutes; the INITIAL value only.

value.description: The effective value for this key -- shape varies per key (string, integer, array of strings, or a mapping of difficulty class to {stage: model}).

layer.description: The winning layer (AD-16): Marshal defaults -> project policy -> invocation flags, last wins, no fourth layer.

raw_source.description: The unwrapped original value from the winning layer, for provenance display. A secret-shaped field's value/raw_source is redacted before this document is rendered.
